description: Which tools integrate with an applicant tracking system (Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, JobAdder and others), from the Work Insiders ATS compatibility data. With a tool given as well, it checks that one pair. Each match says whether the vendor confirms it, the evidence link and the sync direction.

ats.description: ATS name or slug, for example "Bullhorn".

category.description: Category slug or name, for example "ats", "sourcing" or "Email finders". The full list comes from workinsiders_list_categories.

confirmed_only.description: Only integrations the vendor itself confirms.

offset.description: Number of results to skip. next_offset in a response is the start of the next page.

tool.description: Optional tool name or slug, to check a single tool against the ATS.

name: workinsiders_ats_integrations
title: ATS integrations
